# Lucide Static 1.63.0

Official package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/lucide-static/v/1.63.0

Upstream: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide

Documentation: https://lucide.dev/guide/static

Tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/lucide-static/-/lucide-static-1.63.0.tgz

Verified package SHA-512 (base64): `rTBVdPw3vlBsjxfdqm5Tvaa0jI8TMlVAeGefHRIvzUBnEyUE866zSZN34FwpJkXiGN8ER+sy1JCB0XOBEe/QgA==`

The local sprite retains the upstream SVG child elements unchanged, wrapped as named symbols. Renderers provide Lucide defaults: 24 x 24 viewBox, no fill, currentColor stroke, stroke width 2, round caps and joins. No runtime CDN or external request is needed. The full upstream ISC and inherited Feather MIT license notices are included in LICENSE.

Included icons: menu, search, user-round, heart, shopping-bag, house, layout-grid, x, arrow-right, arrow-left, arrow-up-right, chevron-down, chevron-left, chevron-right, globe, truck, ruler, check, plus, minus, zoom-in, lock-keyhole, sliders-horizontal, star, maximize, share-2, eye, eye-off.
